The knight is undefended and White simply captures it with Kxe2, winning a whole knight. This is even better than the forced recapture lines. So **Rb3** wins decisively in all variations.

**Best move:** Rb3

**Main line:** Rb3 Ne2 (or Nxb5 Rxb5 Rxb5) - in both cases White wins material decisively.

**Motif:** hangingPiece, fork

**Coaching note:**
Your rook was attacked, so it had to move. Instead of passive retreats, look for moves that counterattack! Rb3 attacks the knight on c3 back. The knight can't escape to safety—all moves either lose material immediately or allow you to capture undefended pieces. When your piece is under attack, your reply should often create your own threats.
